title: Meet us at …
description: Conference card in the house look: the event's name big, when and where, where to find us there and who's going, with an optional second person. Source: scripts/deck/prague-crawl-2027.html (Prague Crawl 2027, May 13, 2027, Spojka Events, Prague; citing praguecrawl.com).

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.hint: Two to four words: Meet us at, See you at

fields.label: Event
fields.hint: The event's name. Up to two lines; about 30 characters reads best

fields.label: Date
fields.hint: The day or days, e.g. May 13, 2027

fields.label: Where to find us
fields.hint: Booth number or spot at the venue, about 40 characters. Leave the brackets until it's known

fields.label: Photo
fields.hint: Square portrait, face centred; cropped to a circle

fields.label: Second person
fields.hint: Adds a second person under the first

fields.label: Second photo
fields.hint: Square portrait, face centred; shown when Second person is on
